newsitem.title: USA: Slovenia buys 40,000 to 50,000 T Argentine wheat.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia buys 40,000 to 50,000 T Argentine wheat.

text.p: Slovenia on Wednesday night bought between 40,000 to 50,000 tonnes of Argentinian wheat for arrival by February 28, several U.S. exporters said.

But the price of the deal was vague. One U.S. exporter said on Thursday the wheat was bought at around $181 a tonne, cost and freight but another U.S. exporter said he was told the range was higher at between $186 and $191 C and F.
"The (range) was very high but I think there was some extreme quality specs attached to it that are not readily done out of Argentina," the second exporter said.
Earlier this week several U.S. exporters noted that Slovenia was expected to tender for 40,000 to 50,000 tonnes of Canadian or U.S. wheat.
